notes: Extracted from the guide at 2bae394 and docs/evidence/paymentfeedback.md, whose checks ran on 13 October 2026 against 0.1.78-c1fa197. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October); its PaymentFeedback.tsx is still 178 lines and matches the evidence's contract (defaults, the forced capsule modes, renderMedia getting the modes), read from source, not run. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen has no useInstead. The examples drop the guide's Color Mode, its docs-only maxWidth style, and the in-context VStack's Slot gap M; only the failed example sets a mode (AppearanceSystem negative), since positive is the default. The pending and failed icons follow Storybook's stories (ic_info, ic_close); the Sources note says Biscuit's unpublished page suggests the warning and error icons instead, so that choice is not settled. Dark mode and the capsule's missing name are not recorded as gaps, per the flow.

examples.purpose: A successful payment: the amount, the outcome, who it went to, then the date and transaction ID.
examples.jsx:
<PaymentFeedback
  title="₹1,250"
  subtitle="Payment successful"
  body="Sent to Rahul Sharma."
  details={'13 October 2026, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784'}
  iconName="ic_confirm"
/>

from.quote: ₹1,250, “Payment successful”, who it went to, then the date and transaction ID.

examples.purpose: A failed payment: negative with ic_close, and the outcome in words.
examples.jsx:
<PaymentFeedback
  title="₹1,250"
  subtitle="Payment failed"
  body="Something went wrong. Please try again."
  details={'13 October 2026, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784'}
  iconName="ic_close"
  modes={{ AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
/>
